sections.heading: ThreadGroup Class
paragraphs: The Java ThreadGroup class represents a set of threads. It can also include other thread groups. The thread groups form a tree in which every thread group except the initial thread group has a parent.

sections.heading: ThreadGroup Class Declaration
paragraphs: Following is the declaration for java.lang.ThreadGroup class −
code:
public class ThreadGroup
   extends Object
      implements Thread.UncaughtExceptionHandler
